title: Complete mechanism catalog from the AI Engineer transcript research
source_scope: Every supplied deep-read technique plus every takeaway from relevance >=3 talks not deep-read. Completeness is relative to these extraction inputs, not a claim that every possible idea in every subtitle was independently rediscovered in this consolidation.

methodology.loading: Python loaded all deep-read JSON records and all analysis JSON files; triage records were selected only for relevance >=3 and talk IDs absent from the deep-read set.
methodology.deduplication: Normalize Unicode/names, use mechanism-specific curated regex concepts and TF-IDF word/bigram cosine candidates, then manual semantic assignment and weak-match/outlier review. Abbreviations are word-bounded to avoid AST/fast, CLI/explicit and LoRA/exploration false matches. No top-N technique filter and no topic-count target were used.
methodology.mechanism_granularity: A cluster is one transferable intervention; variants and all source-specific changes remain in the cluster. Related but different interventions are kept separate. Source count means distinct talk IDs, not the number of extracted records.

classification_review.manual_conflict_resolution: Later curated assignments resolve earlier draft mappings; one final cluster per input record is enforced.

methodology.source_levels: A deep-read label means the supplied reader artifact was produced by a full-talk reader. This consolidation did not independently reread every talk in full. Triage-only ideas remain provisional even when merged beside a deep-read mechanism.
methodology.quotation: quote is a verbatim local-transcript excerpt (timestamp labels removed, line breaks retained), not a cleaned-up invented quotation. reported_quote and reported_timestamp preserve the extractor input. Normalized-exact and ordered-ellipsis matching locate words; fuzzy or claimed-time locations require confirmation. Eleven initially unresolved records were manually located in the original source. For six translated input quotes on an auto:hi phonetic-English ASR track, the original Devanagari excerpt is verbatim and the English input is explicitly labeled translated/paraphrased; ASR interpretation remains provisional. A matching quote does not prove its surrounding interpretation or performance claim.
methodology.numbers: Input counts and coverage are recomputed in Python. Speaker/reader measurement strings are preserved as reports, never used as independently verified local gains. Effort is an estimate; benefits are directional; overlapping savings must not be added.

note: Test fixture: two real catalog projections with one real source each; not the complete corpus.

techniques.title: Measure context composition and remove irrelevant payloads without an arbitrary window cap

mechanism.summary: Measure context composition and remove irrelevant payloads without an arbitrary window cap
mechanism.representative_explanation: Irrelevant tool schemas, stale instructions and noisy outputs compete with task evidence for attention and cost.

expected_benefit.quality: Better preservation and use of decisive evidence
expected_benefit.reliability: Detect missing, stale or transformed source material
expected_benefit.certainty: Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

failure_modes: Wrong or incomplete source interpretation; same-name techniques can differ in scope.
A proxy improvement can hide quality regression or extra downstream work.
Cache, context, workflow or schema changes can invalidate previously valid evidence.
risk.mitigation: Version the smallest supported change, verify deterministic fixtures and existing live/passive outcomes, stage before production, and preserve a tested rollback. This catalog authorizes no rollout.

how_to_measure_success.acceptance: Compare comparable existing task/risk cohorts; the target metric must improve without a worse defect-escape rate, unauthorized action or required-gate regression. Record sample size, missing cases, p50/p95 where meaningful and false holds. Any numeric target is to be set before an implementation, not claimed achieved here.

sources.quote:

like actually lost more than 75% of the tokens used in the output. So,
sources.input_technique: Tailor tool outputs to what the agent needs (context diet on results, not just definitions)
sources.mechanism_in_source: Tool results stay in context and are re-read on every later turn. GitHub shrank both the default tool surface and the payload each tool returns, keeping only the fields agents use. Combined with server-side composite calls, this cut context use and failures. The transferable idea is to measure which tool outputs dominate context and trim those at the source.
